  public MoveResult processMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    final GameState gameState = getGameState();
    final GameBoardController gameBoardController = gameState.getGameBoardController();
    final MoveResult result = gameBoardController.makeMove(direction);

    if (result instanceof Invalid)
    {
      return result;
    }
    else if (result instanceof Alive)
    {
      final Alive aliveResult = (Alive) result;
      gameState.incrementNumMoves();
      for (Position position : aliveResult.getCollectedExtraLives())
      {
        gameState.increaseNumLives(1);
      }
      gameState.getMoveStack().push(result);
    }
    else if (result instanceof Dead)

      gameState.incrementNumMoves();
      gameState.incrementNumDeaths();
      if (!gameState.hasUnlimitedLives())
      {
        gameState.decrementNumLives();
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Undoes the most recent Alive move from the MoveStack, restoring the board state and reversing any finite life gains, and increments the pop counter.
   * Algorithm:

   *   2. result = gameState.moveStack.peek(); if result is not Alive, return false (only Alive moves are undoable).
   *   3. Call gameBoardController.undoMove(result) to restore player position and collected items.

  public boolean processUndo()
  {
    final GameState gameState = getGameState();
    final MoveStack moveStack = gameState.getMoveStack();

    if (moveStack.isEmpty())
    {
      return false;
    }

    final MoveResult result = moveStack.peek();
    if (!(result instanceof Alive))
    {
      return false;
    }

    final Alive aliveResult = (Alive) result;
    final GameBoardController gameBoardController = gameState.getGameBoardController();
    gameBoardController.undoMove(result);

    if (!gameState.hasUnlimitedLives())
    {
      for (Position position : aliveResult.getCollectedExtraLives())
      {
        gameState.decreaseNumLives(1);
      }
    }

    moveStack.pop();
    moveStack.setPopCount(moveStack.getPopCount() + 1);

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Executes a sliding move for the player in the specified Direction.
   *          The player slides step-by-step from its current Position until
   *          hitting a Wall, reaching the board boundary, landing on a
   *          StopCell, or hitting a Mine. Returns an Alive result for normal
   *          stops (with collected Gems/ExtraLives), a Dead result for Mine
   *          hits (board unchanged), or an Invalid result if the player cannot
   *          move at all.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Determine the current player Position from gameBoard.player and
   *      store it as origPos.
   *   2. Compute the step PositionOffset for the given Direction
   *      (e.g., UP = (-1,0), DOWN = (1,0), LEFT = (0,-1), RIGHT = (0,1)).
   *   3. Initialize curr = origPos, collectedGems = [], collectedExtraLives = [],
   *      and moved = false.
   *   4. Slide step-by-step (loop until a stopping condition):
   *        a. Compute next = curr.offsetByOrNull(offset, numRows, numCols).
   *           If next is null (outside the board), stop sliding
   *           (boundary reached; curr remains the last valid cell).
   *        b. Examine the Cell at next:
   *             - If Wall: stop sliding (curr is the last valid cell before
   *               the Wall).
   *             - If EntityCell containing a Mine: return a Dead result with
   *               newPosition = origPos and minePosition = next. Do NOT collect
   *               items traversed. Board remains unchanged.
   *             - If StopCell: advance curr to next; moved = true; stop sliding
   *               (stop exactly on the StopCell).
   *             - If EntityCell containing a Gem or ExtraLife: record next in
   *               collectedGems or collectedExtraLives respectively; advance
   *               curr to next; moved = true; continue sliding. (Do NOT remove
   *               the entity from the board yet.)
   *             - If empty EntityCell (no entity): advance curr to next;
   *               moved = true; continue sliding.
   *   5. If not moved (the player did not slide at least one cell, i.e. the
   *      first step was blocked by a Wall or boundary), return an Invalid
   *      result. Board remains unchanged.

   * Summary: Executes a sliding move for the player in the specified Direction.
   *          The player slides step-by-step from its current Position until
   *          hitting a Wall, reaching the board boundary, landing on a
   *          StopCell, or hitting a Mine. Returns an Alive result for normal
   *          stops (with collected Gems/ExtraLives), a Dead result for Mine
   *          hits (board unchanged), or an Invalid result if the player cannot
   *          move at all.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Determine the current player Position from gameBoard.player and
   *      store it as origPos.
   *   2. Compute the step PositionOffset for the given Direction
   *      (e.g., UP = (-1,0), DOWN = (1,0), LEFT = (0,-1), RIGHT = (0,1)).
   *   3. Initialize curr = origPos, collectedGems = [], collectedExtraLives = [],
   *      and moved = false.
   *   4. Slide step-by-step (loop until a stopping condition):
   *        a. Compute next = curr.offsetByOrNull(offset, numRows, numCols).
   *           If next is null (outside the board), stop sliding
   *           (boundary reached; curr remains the last valid cell).
   *        b. Examine the Cell at next:
   *             - If Wall: stop sliding (curr is the last valid cell before
   *               the Wall).
   *             - If EntityCell containing a Mine: return a Dead result with
   *               newPosition = origPos and minePosition = next. Do NOT collect
   *               items traversed. Board remains unchanged.
   *             - If StopCell: advance curr to next; moved = true; stop sliding
   *               (stop exactly on the StopCell).
   *             - If EntityCell containing a Gem or ExtraLife: record next in
   *               collectedGems or collectedExtraLives respectively; advance
   *               curr to next; moved = true; continue sliding. (Do NOT remove
   *               the entity from the board yet.)
   *             - If empty EntityCell (no entity): advance curr to next;
   *               moved = true; continue sliding.
   *   5. If not moved (the player did not slide at least one cell, i.e. the
   *      first step was blocked by a Wall or boundary), return an Invalid
   *      result. Board remains unchanged.
   *   6. Build an Alive result with newPosition = curr, origPosition = origPos,
   *      collectedGems, and collectedExtraLives.
   *   7. Apply the move to the board (since the result is determined to be
   *      Alive):
   *        a. For each Position p in collectedGems: remove the Gem entity from
   *           the EntityCell at p.
   *        b. For each Position p in collectedExtraLives: remove the ExtraLife
   *           entity from the EntityCell at p.
   *        c. Set the player entity into the destination EntityCell at curr
   *           (newPosition); remove the player entity from the original cell
   *           at origPos.
   *   8. Return the Alive result.
   * Related Features: gameBoard.player, gameBoard.board, GameBoard.numRows,
   *                   GameBoard.numCols, GameBoard.getCell1, GameBoard.getCell2,
   *                   GameBoard.getEntityCell1, GameBoard.getEntityCell2,

   *                      Dead result (with newPosition = origPos and
   *                      minePosition), or an Invalid result (no movement

   * Pre-condition: gameBoard.player is placed at a valid Position on the board;

   *   - If Alive: The player is at newPosition on the board; all collected
   *     Gems/ExtraLives are removed from the board and recorded in the Alive

   *   - If Dead: The player remains at origPos; the board is unchanged (no

  public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
  {
    Pa21Factory factory = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE;

    // Step 1: determine current player position.
    Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
    EntityCell ownerCell = player.getOwner();
    Position origPos = ownerCell.getPosition();

    // Step 2: compute the step PositionOffset for the given Direction.
    PositionOffset offset = factory.createPositionOffset();
    switch (direction)
    {
      case UP:
        offset.setDRow(-1);
        offset.setDCol(0);
        break;
      case DOWN:
        offset.setDRow(1);
        offset.setDCol(0);
        break;
      case LEFT:
        offset.setDRow(0);
        offset.setDCol(-1);
        break;
      case RIGHT:
        offset.setDRow(0);
        offset.setDCol(1);
        break;
    }

    int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
    int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();

    // Step 3: initialize slide state.
    Position curr = origPos;
    EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
    EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
    boolean moved = false;

    // Step 4: slide step-by-step.
    boolean sliding = true;
    while (sliding)
    {
      Position next = curr.offsetByOrNull2(offset, numRows, numCols);
      if (next == null)
      {
        // Boundary reached: stop sliding, curr remains the last valid cell.
        sliding = false;
        break;
      }

      Cell nextCell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);

      if (nextCell instanceof Wall)
      {
        // Hit a Wall: stop sliding, curr is the last valid cell before the Wall.
        sliding = false;
        break;
      }
      else if (nextCell instanceof EntityCell)
      {
        EntityCell nextEntityCell = (EntityCell) nextCell;
        Entity entity = nextEntityCell.getEntity();

        if (entity instanceof Mine)
        {
          // Stepped on a Mine: return Dead result. Board remains unchanged.
          Dead dead = factory.createDead();
          dead.setNewPosition(origPos);
          dead.setOrigPosition(origPos);
          dead.setMinePosition(next);
          return dead;
        }
        else if (nextCell instanceof StopCell)
        {
          // StopCell: advance curr to next and stop sliding.
          curr = next;
          moved = true;
          sliding = false;
          break;
        }
        else if (entity instanceof Gem)
        {
          // EntityCell with a Gem: record next, advance curr, continue sliding.
          collectedGems.add(next);
          curr = next;
          moved = true;
        }
        else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
        {
          // EntityCell with an ExtraLife: record next, advance curr, continue sliding.
          collectedExtraLives.add(next);
          curr = next;
          moved = true;
        }
        else
        {
          // Empty EntityCell (no entity): advance curr and continue sliding.
          curr = next;
          moved = true;
        }
      }
    }

    // Step 5: if not moved, return an Invalid result. Board remains unchanged.
    if (!moved)
    {
      Invalid invalid = factory.createInvalid();
      return invalid;
    }

    // Step 6: build an Alive result.
    Alive alive = factory.createAlive();
    alive.setNewPosition(curr);
    alive.setOrigPosition(origPos);
    alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
    alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);

    // Step 7: apply the move to the board.
    //   a. Remove collected Gems from their cells.
    for (Position p : collectedGems)
    {
      EntityCell cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(p);
      cell.setEntity(null);
    }
    //   b. Remove collected ExtraLives from their cells.
    for (Position p : collectedExtraLives)
    {
      EntityCell cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(p);
      cell.setEntity(null);
    }
    //   c. Set the player entity into the destination cell and remove it from the original cell.
    EntityCell destCell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(curr);
    destCell.setEntity(player);
    EntityCell origCell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(origPos);
    origCell.setEntity(null);

    // Step 8: return the Alive result.
    return alive;
  }

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Reverses a previously executed Alive move on the game board.
   *          Restores the player's position to the original Position and
   *          places the previously collected Gems and ExtraLives back into
   *          their original cells.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Verify that prevMove is an Alive instance; if not, do nothing and
   *      return.
   *   2. Restore the player position:
   *        a. Set the player entity (gameBoard.player) into the EntityCell
   *           at prevMove.origPosition.
   *        b. Remove the player entity from the EntityCell at
   *           prevMove.newPosition.
   *   3. For each Position p in prevMove.collectedGems: place a new Gem
   *      entity into the EntityCell at p.
   *   4. For each Position p in prevMove.collectedExtraLives: place a new
   *      ExtraLife entity into the EntityCell at p.
   * Related Features: gameBoard.player, gameBoard.board, GameBoard.getCell1,
   *                   GameBoard.getCell2, GameBoard.getEntityCell1,
   *                   GameBoard.getEntityCell2, MoveResult.newPosition,
   *                   Valid.origPosition, Alive.collectedGems,
   *                   Alive.collectedExtraLives
   * Related Classes: Player, Alive, Gem, ExtraLife, EntityCell, Cell, Position,
   *                  MoveResult, Valid
   * Input: prevMove : MoveResult - the Alive MoveResult to undo (must be an
   *                   Alive instance with origPosition, collectedGems,
   *                   collectedExtraLives).
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: prevMove must be an Alive instance; the board state must
   *                currently match the state after the move (player at
   *                newPosition, collected items removed from the board).
   * Post-condition: The player is back at origPosition; all previously
   *                 collected Gems and ExtraLives are restored on the board at
   *                 their original positions; the newPosition cell no longer
   *                 contains the player.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove)
  {
    // Step 1: verify that prevMove is an Alive instance.
    if (!(prevMove instanceof Alive))
    {
      return;
    }
    Alive alive = (Alive) prevMove;

    Pa21Factory factory = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE;

    // Step 2: restore the player position.
    //   a. Set the player entity into the EntityCell at origPosition.
    //   b. Remove the player entity from the EntityCell at newPosition.
    Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
    EntityCell origCell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(alive.getOrigPosition());
    origCell.setEntity(player);
    EntityCell newCell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(alive.getNewPosition());
    newCell.setEntity(null);

    // Step 3: place a new Gem entity back into each collectedGems cell.
    for (Position p : alive.getCollectedGems())
    {
      EntityCell cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(p);
      Gem gem = factory.createGem();
      cell.setEntity(gem);
    }

    // Step 4: place a new ExtraLife entity back into each collectedExtraLives cell.
    for (Position p : alive.getCollectedExtraLives())
    {
      EntityCell cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(p);
      ExtraLife extraLife = factory.createExtraLife();
      cell.setEntity(extraLife);
    }
  }
